background_determinism.root_cause: Background population was applied before the first tick of the episode, so placement scoring used the previous episode route (provider publishes the route on tick); the first configuration of each scenario (A) therefore differed. Fixed in PedestrianBehaviorWorld.prepare_background.

counterfactual_prefixes.mode: LOCKSTEP camera semantics (stride 2, one-frame delay) for counterfactual arms only

comfort_metric_validation.conclusion: Position-derived maximum deceleration agrees with the speed-signal value; the >15 m/s2 peaks are real CARLA full-brake events at low speed, not a measurement artifact. p95 deceleration and hard-braking time are reported as robust statistics.

prediction.note: Closed-loop logs; the formal one-time TEST admission is recorded in the artifact manifest.
